create_masked_transform: create a masked gradient transformation that applies an inner optimizer only to selected parameters
skip_weight_decay_for_biases: skip weight decay for bias and batch norm parameters using a mask function that filters 1D arrays
apply_mask_with_callable: apply a callable mask to dynamically filter which parameter tree leaves receive the inner transformation
mask_extra_args_alongside_updates: mask extra arguments with the same tree structure as params when mask_compatible_extra_args is enabled
use_masked_state_for_inner_transform: use MaskedState to maintain inner transform state only for parameters with a True mask value
